claims: Test hosts can optionally list their prepared synthetic source IDs through an internal host callback. Existing protected Initiative inspection resolves and filters those IDs for the current authenticated subject and session, scans at most 64 candidates and projects at most 16 suggestions using existing explanation codes and source references. Listing does not create an event, invoke inference, change policy or issue output.

Duplicate, consumed, foreign-subject, foreign-session, future, expired, malformed and unsupported entries are withheld. Failed host listing returns an explicit unavailable explanation without exposing the host error. The existing simulate path independently resolves and checks the submitted source again; the catalog confers no authority.

The Conversation picker labels kind, text/speech output and expiry. Selection fills the existing request fields, moves identifiers into read-only details and proposes the matching output modality. Adjacent Enable case output, Run and Refresh controls keep the sequence together. Empty catalogs disable selection/run and explain the required host preparation. Resolve-only hosts retain manual source entry. No microphone starts through this workflow.

An observed playback regression returned cancelled for a lost acknowledgment that should remain unknown. Output-only speech now retains its own timer-expiry cause instead of relying only on a later wall-clock comparison. A deterministic timer-only regression test covers that ordering; the existing joined lost-acknowledgment test and full regression suite pass with retained uncertainty and no replay.

Browser verification selects and submits a host-prepared case without manually entering source identifiers, uses the adjacent output control, receives one text opening, and refreshes to an empty catalog without another inference call. Mobile layout has no horizontal overflow. Screenshots were inspected separately from Human acceptance.
